note: City of Ravenna campground in Annevar Park, a row of water-and-electric pads along the north edge of the grassy park (some 30-amp, some 50-amp). Dump station between the park and the Public Works building. First come, by donation box, up to 7 days; longer stays through City Hall. No showers noted. The grounds also host the annual Annevar festival and demolition derby. --Claude
summary: City page (two copies) confirms 10 water+electric RV hookups, dump station, first come first served, City Hall 308-452-3273 (matches stored phone); sites/facilities/booking upgraded to manual. No dated rate: the city posts none and the only figure is a 2023 Campendium donation of $20 a night (not usable: the operator has a web page). Pin OK (in the park beside the pedestal row). Not waterfront stands.
